item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. We must act before that threshold is crossed—not count on rules we cannot enforce afterward.

2. We cannot govern what we cannot control. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control its actions. We demand prevention, not promises of oversight after the fact.

3. We reject the promise that governments can keep superintelligent AI under control. If it is built within the next 20 years, they will be unable to control what it does. We must stop treating regulation as a guarantee of safety.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe the central question about superintelligent AI is not who will regulate it, but whether governments will retain the power to enforce their decisions. Our answer is clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. We cannot accept a future in which public authority exists on paper while decisions that shape our lives escape public control. We must act before that loss of control occurs. That means confronting the race to build superintelligence now, rejecting empty assurances of oversight, and demanding policies that put prevention ahead of deployment. We refuse to mistake permission to build for the power to govern.
